pageTitle: Klacks for Israel | Scheduling That Survives Reserve Call-ups

hero.badge: For security firms, hospitals & staffing agencies in Israel
hero.titleHtml: Scheduling built for a volatile reality.
hero.subtitle: Reserve call-ups (Miluim) and Shabbat restrictions create planning gaps no generic scheduler is built for. Klacks combines instant, compliant replacement planning with Shabbat-aware autofill.
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the core app interface ships in German, English, French and Italian; the Klacksy AI assistant additionally understands Hebrew.

items.title: Reserve call-ups without warning
items.text: Miluim orders can pull staff out with almost no notice, tearing holes into security, hospital and staffing rosters.

items.title: Shabbat work is restricted by default
items.text: Under the Hours of Work and Rest Law, Shabbat employment needs a state permit, and employees can refuse it on religious grounds — get the rota wrong and you're both understaffed and non-compliant.

items.title: Layered overtime & rest-day pay
items.text: Standard overtime (125%/150%) combines with the 50% rest-day premium when work falls on Shabbat — manual payroll prep is error-prone.

solutions.title: How Klacks handles Israel's planning reality
solutions.subtitle: Crisis-resilient rostering, not a generic 24/7 planner.

items.title: Instant replacement on reserve call-up
items.text: The moment a reservist is called up, the Recovery Engine finds the best qualified stand-in from your pool — without touching the reservist's own contract data.

items.title: Shabbat opt-out, respected automatically
items.text: Staff mark their Shabbat availability once; the autofill engine reliably excludes them from Shabbat shifts from then on.

items.title: Rest-day premiums calculated correctly
items.text: Klacks' typed surcharge engine applies the combined overtime + rest-day premium so payroll gets accurate figures, not manual guesswork.

items.title: Friday/Saturday week & Shabbat windows
items.text: Calendar rules handle the Friday/Saturday week and Shabbat start/end times natively.

items.title: Payroll-ready export
items.text: Klacks already exports hours, overtime and allowances to CSV/Excel; a Hashavshevet-compatible format is next on our roadmap.

klacksy.title: Klacksy: the assistant built into your team's workflow
klacksy.text: Klacksy isn’t a bolted-on marketing chatbot — it’s embedded directly in the Klacks interface. Staff and schedulers ask about shifts via chat, request shift swaps, or resolve qualification conflicts within the team. A built-in skills and rules system ensures Klacksy only ever suggests changes that actually match the qualifications and working-time limits of the people involved.

example.title: A reservist is called up mid-cycle
example.text: Klacks locks the reservist's slot, surfaces the best compliant replacement from the pool, and leaves the rest of the roster untouched — no manual re-planning.
